selectionPolicy: Select only complete source sentences from already-published 100%-provenance articles. Exclude sentences containing violence, death, adult, sectarian, polemical, or otherwise child-unsuitable vocabulary. No substantive sentence is generated or paraphrased.
illustrationPolicy: Deterministic non-figurative inline SVG illustrations only: books, stars, palms, paths, houses, water, geometric ornaments and place silhouettes. No depiction of the Prophet or identifiable people.

integrity.note: Each child article is a light source-preserved view built from safe sentences already present in a genuine published source article; the source article remains canonical and provenance is inherited.
